title: Iterator Pattern
description: Access elements of a collection sequentially.

data.text:
**Iterator Pattern**

Provides a way to access elements of an aggregate object sequentially without exposing its underlying representation.

C# provides built-in iterator support through:
- foreach loop
- IEnumerable<T> interface
- yield return keyword

data.title: Iterator in C#
Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Iterators are fundamental to C# collection traversal and LINQ.
